Name: Kenneth's Popsicles and Sundaes
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]9 new popsicles, cones, sundaes & parfaits for Kenneth's Dessert Shop: banana cream popsicle, strawberry ice pop, rocket pop, double chocolate cone, vanilla cherry swirl, chocolate cherry sundae, caramel crunch, strawberry parfait & triple cherry bowl - recipes + buffs![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds 9 custom popsicles, ice cream cones, sundaes and parfaits to Kenneth's Dessert Shop - banana cream popsicle, strawberry ice pop, rocket pop popsicle, double chocolate ice cream cone, vanilla cherry swirl cone, chocolate cherry sundae glass, caramel crunch sundae, strawberry swirl parfait, and triple cherry sundae bowl - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requires Kenneth's Dessert Shop - this mod's items are sold in its Shop1.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Customization: By default, all popsicles, cones, sundaes and parfaits appear in Kenneth's Dessert Shop Shop1. If you want to customize your selection and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual items to remove them from the shop along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling an item restores it to the shop and its recipe to your kitchen.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]More details can be found in ReadMe.txt.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Please do not reupload this mod or include it in modpacks without permission.[/b][/size]
